name: Functor
purpose: Things you can map a function over without changing their shape. Laws: `fmap id == id`, `fmap (f . g) == fmap f . fmap g`.

name: Applicative
purpose: Apply functions that are themselves inside a context; combine independent effects.

name: Monad
purpose: Sequence effects where the next step depends on the previous result. `do` notation turns into `>>=`.

name: MonadFail
purpose: Monads that can fail with a message; used when a pattern on the left of `<-` in `do` does not match.

name: Foldable
purpose: Containers that can be collapsed to a summary value: lists, `Maybe`, `Set`, `Map k`, pairs...

name: Traversable
purpose: Walk a container performing an effect for each element and rebuild the same shape.

name: Semigroup
purpose: Types with an associative combine operation.

name: Monoid
purpose: A Semigroup with an identity element `mempty`.

name: Eq
purpose: Equality testing.

name: Ord
purpose: Totally ordered types.

name: Bounded
purpose: Types with a smallest and largest value (`Int`, `Char`, `Bool`; not `Integer`).

name: Enum
purpose: Sequentially ordered types; powers `[a ..]`, `[a, b ..]`, `[a .. c]`, `[a, b .. c]`.

name: Show
purpose: Convert to a `String`.

name: Read
purpose: Parse from a `String`; inverse of `Show`.

name: Num
purpose: Basic arithmetic. Integer literals are `fromInteger n`.

name: Real
purpose: Numbers that convert exactly to `Rational`.

name: Integral
purpose: Whole-number types: `Int`, `Integer`, `Word`.

name: Fractional
purpose: Numbers with division: `Double`, `Float`, `Rational`. Decimal literals are `fromRational r`.

name: Floating
purpose: Exponentials, logs, trig: `Float`, `Double`.
minimal: `pi, exp, log, sin, cos, asin, acos, atan, sinh, cosh, asinh, acosh, atanh`

name: RealFrac
purpose: Fractional numbers that can be rounded to whole numbers.

name: RealFloat
purpose: Internals of IEEE floating-point numbers.
minimal: `floatRadix, floatDigits, floatRange, decodeFloat, encodeFloat, isNaN, isInfinite, isDenormalized, isNegativeZero, isIEEE`
